title: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak
description: Crafted inputs manipulate the LLM to ignore system instructions, bypass safety constraints, and execute arbitrary malicious directives.
mitigation: Deploy semantic prompt firewall (SPEP-01) and strict dual-channel instruction-data separation (SPEP-02).

title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
description: LLM inadvertently reveals confidential information, PII, intellectual property, or training data in its completions.
mitigation: Implement output token DLP scrubbing, regex pattern masking, and data minimization.

title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
description: Compromised third-party datasets, pre-trained base models, fine-tuning checkpoints, or external plugins.
mitigation: Vetting of AI vendor dependencies, signed model artifacts, and SBOM vulnerability scanning.

title: Data and Model Poisoning
description: Adversarial data introduced into training pipelines or vector databases to create backdoors or bias.
mitigation: Strict data provenance tracking, cryptographic hash verification, and vector partition isolation.

title: Improper Output Handling
description: Output generated by the LLM is passed directly to downstream systems (browsers, SQL interpreters) without validation.
mitigation: Context-aware output sanitization, strict JSON schema validation, and SQL parameterization.

title: Excessive Agency & Unconstrained Tools
description: Granting excessive permissions, unrestricted tool-calling autonomy, or network access to an LLM agent.
mitigation: Least-privilege RBAC for tool APIs, step-up human-in-the-loop authorization for destructive verbs (SPEP-05).

title: System Prompt Leakage
description: Adversary probes the model to extract proprietary system prompts, internal architecture details, or hidden rules.
mitigation: Hardened system role encapsulation and output guardrails filtering internal policy keywords.

title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
description: Unauthorized access to or manipulation of vector databases used in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
mitigation: Multitenant partition boundaries and access control checks on vector similarity search queries.

title: Misinformation & Hallucination
description: The LLM produces factually incorrect, fabricated, or biased outputs with high confidence.
mitigation: 8-step grounded RAG verification, citation checks, and confidence scoring.

title: Unbounded Consumption & Model DoS
description: Adversary forces recursive generation or high token consumption to exhaust cloud budgets or cause outages.
mitigation: Token rate limiting, max completion caps, and compute quota alarms.
